What is prompt injection, in one sentence?¶{{c1::Text the model reads as DATA gets obeyed as INSTRUCTIONS}}
column2: Everything in context is just tokens — no trust label exists.

column1: What is direct vs indirect prompt injection, and which is dangerous for agents?¶Direct = {{c1::typed by the user}}; indirect = {{c1::planted in content the agent reads}}; dangerous one = {{c1::indirect}}
column2: Planted in a document, email, web page, or repo file.

column1: What are the five prompt-injection families?¶{{c1::Direct override}} · {{c1::role-play framing}} · {{c1::encoding tricks}} · {{c1::output-channel abuse}} · {{c1::indirect (planted content)}}

column2: All three present = one poisoned document can exfiltrate (16/06/2025).

column1: Why can't prompt hardening fix the lethal trifecta?¶{{c1::The model can't reliably distinguish injected instructions from data}}
